content.text:
The orders page is fixed. The orders table header was missing its "Total" column heading. The rows had six cells but the header only had five, so every column after Status sat under the wrong heading.

I added `<th class="num">Total</th>` to the header in `site/orders.html`. The visual tests for orders now match the approved screenshots at desktop and phone size. All 28 visual and functional tests pass.

STATUS: DONE
